## Description

A print view of today's schedule, one page per doctor, in the facility time zone: time, token, first name and age, doctor and a reason code. No phone number and no national or insurance ID. Printing is a read of patient data, so it is audited with who printed it. Deferred until pilot interviews say the desk needs a paper fallback.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Choosing Print day sheet produces a one-page-per-doctor sheet in the facility time zone.
- [ ] **AC2.** The sheet excludes phone numbers and national IDs (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** An access-log entry records who printed it.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
